verdict.rationale: Netlify's official CLI documents running local dev servers, and a community user says Netlify Dev makes it easier to experiment locally with serverless functions. However, nothing in the evidence shows the local environment matches the production runtime. One hands-on user hit an undocumented netlify.toml [dev] configuration error, and another keeps separate nginx configs for dev parity, which points to rough edges rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: documented production-runtime parity (functions, edge, redirects, blobs/db emulation), clear [dev] configuration docs, independent corroboration that local behavior matches production

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime

citations.quote: Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
They see Netlify Dev as making it easier to experiment with lambdas/serverless.
